criteria.requirement: Implement tomlkit.merging.merge_documents(base,overlay,*,arrays="replace",conflicts="replace"). Deep-copy base, recursively merge mapping children, and choose explicit replace/append/unique for arrays (including arrays of tables, using native value equality for uniqueness). Copy incoming mutable nodes, preserve unaffected base comments/layout and validate the final serialized TOML. conflicts="error" rejects differing scalar/type conflicts without changing either input. Reject unknown policies/nonmapping overlay; preserve existing parse/dumps behavior and do not infer merges from implicit global settings.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
